rca_of_issue: iter93 introduced a TDZ crash by adding `stopAndTranscribe` to `handleMicPress`'s useCallback deps array while `stopAndTranscribe` was still declared BELOW `handleMicPress` in source order. `const` declarations are hoisted but stay in the Temporal Dead Zone until their initialiser runs, so reading `stopAndTranscribe` from the deps array (evaluated eagerly during render, top-to-bottom) threw `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'stopAndTranscribe' before initialization`. iter94 fixed this by a single mechanical move: the entire `const stopAndTranscribe = useCallback(...)` block now sits above `handleMicPress` (order: beginCapture → stopAndTranscribe → handleMicPress → acceptRationaleAndRequest). No behavioural code was changed; deps arrays, internal logic, and comments are identical to iter93. Verified by loading the previously-crashing screens (/table/fp-cafe-permanent, /recipes/<id>, /dm/<id>) in the preview and observing clean mounts with the composer + mic button visible.
